company.name: Sequence
company.shortDescription: Sequence provides AI-powered revenue operations software for CPQ, billing, invoicing, accounts receivable, and revenue recognition.
company.description: Sequence develops AI-powered revenue operations software that unifies configure, price, quote (CPQ), contract intake, billing, invoicing, accounts receivable, collections, and revenue recognition within a single platform. The software automates quote-to-cash workflows, manages customer contracts and subscription lifecycles, generates invoices, tracks payments, and supports financial reconciliation. The comapny integrates with CRM, ERP, accounting, payment, and business systems to synchronize commercial and financial data while providing reporting, workflow automation, approval processes, audit trails, and operational controls for finance and revenue teams.
